name: Woodrow H. Pollack
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property attorney in Tampa, Florida
about: Woodrow H. Pollack is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Tampa, Florida. Woodrow Pollack focuses on Intellectual Property issues.

Woodrow Pollack received Super Lawyers designation for 2014 - 2026. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 2006. Before practicing law, he attended law school at Stetson University College of Law and graduated in 2006.
